rationale.conceptual: The method relies on well-established DFT with GGA-PBE and a standard length-gauge SHG calculation as implemented in common codes. No custom algorithm, new derivation, or deep conceptual innovation is required.
rationale.execution: The pipeline includes multiple computational stages: structure preparation, SCF+bands for two compounds, SHG tensor calculations, and post-processing extractions. Dependencies between SCF wavefunctions and SHG, plus environment setup (DFT code with nonlinear optics module), raise the orchestration burden to a moderate level.
